Decided 2026-10-05 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#235. Question: a value in the refresh_token member of a token response or the refresh_token parameter of a refresh request is a credential whatever its shape? Options: require a documented prefix, alphabet or width (Airtable states none) or flag only one recognised shape; or leave the case a draft. Decision: flag any such value, no subtype inference. Reason: the provider pages document only that the carrier exists, not its value format, so the expectation rests on project policy and is not a provider rule or a fact. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's instruction.
events.dissent: The provider pages document the carrier but state no value format, so a position-only rule can flag non-secrets or miss a differently shaped secret; leaving the case a draft would claim nothing.
events.reversingEvidence: A provider statement of the value format or of the carrier's confidentiality that contradicts this outcome, or a second maintainer's retro-review that disputes it.
